package ssa

import (
	IMPORT_BASE
	"IMPORT_IR"
	"IMPORT_OBJ"
	"IMPORT_SRC"
	"IMPORT_SYS"
	"IMPORT_TYPECHECK"
	"IMPORT_TYPES"
	LOWER_IMPORT
	"encoding/binary"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"sort"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

type snapshotLowerFrontend struct{ Frontend }

func (*snapshotLowerFrontend) Log() bool { return false }
func (*snapshotLowerFrontend) Fatalf(pos src.XPos, f string, args ...any) {
	panic(fmt.Sprintf("%d:%s", pos.Line(), fmt.Sprintf(f, args...)))
}
func (*snapshotLowerFrontend) Warnl(src.XPos, string, ...any) {}

func TestSyncgoNativeSnapshot(t *testing.T) {
	mode := os.Getenv("SYNCGO_TARGET")
	target := struct {
		arch  string
		size  int
		order binary.ByteOrder
	}{strings.Split(mode, "-")[0], 8, binary.LittleEndian}
	switch target.arch {
	case "386", "arm", "mips", "mipsle":
		target.size = 4
	}
	switch target.arch {
	case "mips", "mips64", "ppc64", "s390x":
		target.order = binary.BigEndian
	}
	_ = ir.PAUTO
	SETUP
	LOWER_FEATURES.GOAMD64 = 1
	LOWER_FEATURES.GOARM.Version = 7
	LOWER_FEATURES.GOPPC64 = 8
	LOWER_FEATURES.GORISCV64 = 20
	switch mode {
	case "amd64-v4":
		LOWER_FEATURES.GOAMD64 = 4
	case "arm-v5":
		LOWER_FEATURES.GOARM.Version = 5
	case "ppc64-v10":
		LOWER_FEATURES.GOPPC64 = 10
	case "riscv64-v23":
		LOWER_FEATURES.GORISCV64 = 23
	}
	var out []string
	add := func(label string, args ...any) { out = append(out, label+":"+fmt.Sprint(args...)) }
	for _, soft := range []bool{false, true} {
		LOWER_FEATURES.GOARM.SoftFloat = soft
		LINK.Flag_shared = soft
		cfg := UP.NewConfig(target.arch, *UP.NewTypes(), LINK, true, soft)
		add("config", cfg.arch, " ", cfg.PtrSize, " ", cfg.RegSize, " ", cfg.BigEndian, " ", cfg.SoftFloat, " ", cfg.FPReg, " ", cfg.LinkReg, " ", cfg.hasGReg, " ", cfg.unalignedOK, " ", cfg.haveCondSelect, " ", cfg.haveByteSwap(2), " ", cfg.haveByteSwap(4), " ", cfg.haveByteSwap(8))
		add("masks", cfg.gpRegMask, " ", cfg.fpRegMask, " ", cfg.simdRegMask, " ", cfg.specialRegMask, " ", cfg.fp32RegMask, " ", cfg.fp64RegMask)
		add("regs", cfg.intParamRegs, " ", cfg.floatParamRegs, " ", cfg.registers)
		add("shared-clobber", LINK.Flag_shared, " ", DIAG_TABLE[Op386LoweredWB].reg.clobbers)
		add("callbacks", cfg.lowerBlock != nil, " ", cfg.lowerValue != nil, " ", cfg.lateLowerBlock != nil, " ", cfg.lateLowerValue != nil, " ", cfg.splitLoad != nil)
		add("abi", cfg.ABI0.Which(), " ", cfg.ABI1.Which(), " ", cfg.ABI0.LocalsOffset(), " ", cfg.ABI1.LocalsOffset())
		var keys []int64
		for k := range cfg.mulRecipes {
			keys = append(keys, k)
		}
		sort.Slice(keys, func(i, j int) bool { return keys[i] < keys[j] })
		add("recipes", len(keys))
		fresh := func() *Func {
			cache := new(Cache)
			cache.Reset()
			f := cfg.NewFunc(&snapshotLowerFrontend{}, cache)
			f.Name = "lower"
			f.Type = TY.NewSignature(nil, nil, nil)
			f.ABISelf = cfg.ABI1
			f.pass = &pass{name: "lower"}
			f.Entry = f.NewBlock(BlockRet)
			f.Entry.Pos = LINK.PosTable.XPos(src.MakePos(src.NewFileBase("lower.go", "lower.go"), 10, 1))
			return f
		}
		f := fresh()
		b := f.Entry
		pos := b.Pos
		it := cfg.Types.Int32
		x := b.NewValue0I(pos, OpArg, it, 0)
		y := b.NewValue0I(pos, OpArg, it, 4)
		mem := b.NewValue0(pos, OpInitMem, TY.TypeMem)
		sp := b.NewValue0(pos, OpSP, cfg.Types.Uintptr)
		ptr := b.NewValue1I(pos, OpOffPtr, TY.NewPtr(it), 16, sp)
		k := f.ConstInt32(it, 9)
		v := b.NewValue2(pos, OpAdd32, it, x, y)
		v = b.NewValue2(pos, OpMul32, it, v, k)
		v = b.NewValue2(pos, OpXor32, it, v, y)
		mem = b.NewValue3A(pos, OpStore, TY.TypeMem, it, ptr, v, mem)
		b.SetControl(mem)
		checkFunc(f)
		numberLines(f)
		lower(f)
		lateLower(f)
		deadcode(f)
		checkFunc(f)
		checkLower(f)
		add("graph", f.String())
		// Probe actual feature-gated rule selection. A target without the feature may
		// intentionally leave this isolated value unchanged; it is not a full pass.
		if !soft {
			f := fresh()
			b := f.Entry
			typ := cfg.Types.Int64
			if target.arch == "arm" {
				typ = cfg.Types.Float64
			}
			if target.arch == "amd64" {
				typ = cfg.Types.Int32
			}
			x := b.NewValue0(b.Pos, OpArg, typ)
			y := b.NewValue0I(b.Pos, OpArg, typ, 8)
			var v *Value
			switch target.arch {
			case "amd64":
				n := b.NewValue1(b.Pos, OpAMD64NOTL, typ, y)
				v = b.NewValue2(b.Pos, OpAMD64ANDL, typ, x, n)
			case "arm":
				a := b.NewValue0I(b.Pos, OpArg, typ, 16)
				m := b.NewValue2(b.Pos, OpARMMULD, typ, x, y)
				v = b.NewValue2(b.Pos, OpARMADDD, typ, a, m)
			case "ppc64", "ppc64le":
				v = b.NewValue1(b.Pos, OpBswap64, typ, x)
			case "riscv64":
				v = b.NewValue2(b.Pos, OpMax64, typ, x, y)
			}
			if v != nil {
				changed := cfg.lowerValue(v)
				add("feature", changed, " ", v.Op, " ", v.AuxInt, " ", v.Args)
			}
		}

		// Run every native strength-reduction closure in a separate graph. Retain the
		// opcode, argument and AuxInt sequence for comparison with the pinned source.
		for _, key := range keys {
			f := fresh()
			b := f.Entry
			m := b.NewValue0(b.Pos, OpArg, cfg.Types.Int64)
			x := b.NewValue0(b.Pos, OpArg, cfg.Types.Int64)
			result := cfg.mulRecipes[key].build(m, x)
			var code []string
			for _, v := range b.Values {
				code = append(code, fmt.Sprintf("%d/%s/%d/%v", v.ID, v.Op, v.AuxInt, v.Args))
			}
			add("recipe", key, " ", cfg.mulRecipes[key].cost, " ", result.ID, " ", code)
		}
	}
	// Pure arithmetic helpers retain native integer boundary behavior.
	for _, width := range []uint{8, 16, 32, 64} {
		for _, d := range []int64{1, 2, 3, 5, 7, 9, 17, 127, 255, 257, 65535, 2147483647, 9223372036854775807} {
			if width < 64 && uint64(d) >= uint64(1)<<width {
				continue
			}
			if umagicOK(width, d) {
				add("umagic", width, " ", d, " ", umagic(width, d))
			}
			if (width == 64 || uint64(d) < uint64(1)<<(width-1)) && smagicOK(width, d) {
				add("smagic", width, " ", d, " ", smagic(width, d))
			}
			if udivisibleOK(width, d) {
				add("divisible", width, " ", d, " ", udivisible(width, d))
			}
		}
	}
	data, err := json.Marshal(out)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	fmt.Printf("SYNCGO_IR=%s\n", data)
}
